proposed_facts.reason: Canonical controller returns when the fighter is absent. Material initialization traverses 51 indices and configures successful items; the material setters write hurt-capsule offsets, scale and ground_or_air, not model scale or visibility.
The two const objects and their consumers support the stated helper roles. Missing-fighter fallback language is correctly removed without asserting compiled placement.

Startup caches and forwards the embedded descriptor, guards random sampling and does not check constructor failure. Ground producers supply a cached identifier and archive-selected kind, potentially -1; the generator stores these in unused reserved entries and retains the descriptor on success.

The complete controller supports the exceptional fighter branches, phase restrictions, recreation ordering and timer-dependent geometry requests. Vector definitions independently confirm target-relative residual rather than capped movement. Generator disable preserves its manager.

Initialization, encounter transitions, missing-fighter return and refresh-flag consumption match the source. Material destruction conditionally requests another refresh. Geometry disabling is delayed until updates entering with timer zero, and generation can be re-enabled without reconstructing its manager.

contradictions.reason: Accept compiled-evidence deferrals for all section membership, composition, ordering and offset claims. Source supports the pointer, const objects, callback registration, archive binding and numeric consumers, but does not independently establish their compiled sections. This reconciles the section-related unresolved facts and both section-attribution links without treating them as verified layout knowledge.

Accept correction of the zero-vector fallback and material-configuration claims through proposed facts 0 and 1. No-fighter processing stops immediately; successful proxies receive hurt-capsule configuration rather than model visibility or model-scale configuration.

Accept correction of route-bounds interpretation through proposed fact 2. The optional arguments originate from cached identifier storage and eligible archive kinds; construction failure remains unchecked and retained descriptor lifetime is preserved.

Accept camera correction in proposed fact 3 and the document. The timer-zero expression leaves a target-relative residual, not a maximum movement step. The camera-tracking relation remains supported, while its old distance-limited-step link rationale is explicitly deferred because link writes are out of scope.

Accept phase timing and generator-lifetime corrections in proposed facts 3 and 4. Geometry disable is requested only after the timer has reached zero and can repeat; completion restores geometry and generation. The rendered Shutdown name must not be read as manager destruction.

The second fighter sample is previous position, not velocity. Accept deferral of categorical splash/water-entry identity in the affected facts and effect link: the source proves strict downward Y crossing and null-guarded generator scaling, but no water-region test or asset identity. Retain the rendered splash name only as a tentative hypothesis.
